# lmw watch add

Add a watch

```
lmw watch add KIND [TARGET] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw watch add posts linkedin.com/in/grace-hopper --once
  lmw watch add jobs "go developer" --location Spain --workplace remote --every 2h
  lmw watch add messages --to phone
  lmw watch add comments https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7123456789012345678/
```

### Options

```
      --every duration     how often to check (15m or more) (default 30m0s)
  -h, --help               help for add
      --location string    jobs: where the job is
      --note string        why you watch this, shown in the list
      --once               end the watch after its first notification (the next post, the next message)
      --posted string      jobs: posted in the last day, week or month
      --to string          the notification channel to use (default: all of them)
      --workplace string   jobs: onsite, remote or hybrid, comma separated
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
